ticket.subject: Feature request: custom permissions
ticket.body_text:
Good morning,

We would like to define our own roles, for example someone who can edit projects but not see billing.

Our contractors currently see more than they need.

There is no deadline here. Thanks for listening.

Best regards,
Henrik Szabo
founder, Wrenfield Partners

label_notes: clean feature (feature-granular-roles): a request for something the product does not do is P4; urgency low: no time pressure.
